The '''Trench''' was a location where [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sanos]], an officer in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], served for three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before being transferred to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to serve under [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Razer]].
